content.value: Consider a hash table of size 7 with hash function h(k) = k mod 7. Draw the table that results after inserting in the given order, the values 20, 27, 14, 52, 26 for each of the scenarios below: i) When collision is handled by linear probing.
ii) When collision is handled by double hashing using a second hash function $h ^ { \prime } ( k ) = 5 - ( k \mathrm { m o d } 5 ) .$
